'''December 2000 Virginia Beach tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Virginia Beach, VA on 30 December 2000. [[Paul Evans]] won it. It is known from Brian Catalino's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1579">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-30-virginia-beach-va-12-30-00d1579/ virginia-beach-va-12-30-00], DeckTech (brian "darkjedi2000" catalino, 30 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-30-virginia-beach-va-12-30-00d1579/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Virginia Beach, VA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Evans]]
